sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

The game also features a unique power-up system, where players can collect ammo to increase their shots or become immortal for a short period of time. However, players must be careful not to touch a malus (an astronaut with a red cross), as this will result in a loss of one point. The game also features a variety of obstacles, including asteroids, planets, and other space debris, which adds an extra layer of complexity to the gameplay.
